package.name: hybrid_astar_planner
package.description:
Hybrid A* global planner plugin for move_base_flex. Produces kinematically feasible, heading-aware paths for a non-holonomic (differential-drive) mower, used as the TransitionPlanner so the robot reaches mow-strip starts with the correct orientation without large in-place rotations near obstacles.
Core search ported from Karl Kurzer's path_planner (BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2017 Karl Kurzer) and adapted for ROS Noetic + costmap_2d + differential-drive kinematics.
package.author: Karl Kurzer (original Hybrid A* implementation)
